title:
POV: GIVING FLOWERS TO
STRANGERS IN JERUSALEM 🇮🇱
beats: HOOK: her face as the flower arrives - surprise, 'happy holiday', 'for health and joy', 'thank you so much' [framing: manual full-height centre crop - the auto face-aim put the crop top-left on passers-by in V1 r1]

SECOND STRANGER, different world: the street cleaner - 'this is for you, we want to make you happy', his full smile, the girls add roses, 'thank you very much' [in-point moved 11.25->12.95: r1 opened this beat on a whip-pan blur]

BACK TO HER: 'what is this? you made me so happy!' and the caregiver 'that's how it should be' [framing: manual full-height centre crop - the auto face-aim put the crop top-left on passers-by in V1 r1]

THE TURN: 'are you Muslim? - yes' / 'I'm Jewish' - and the handshake [out 36.25->36.33: r2 post-render check heard a word across the join] [framing: manual full-height centre crop - r3 auto-aim left him half out of frame at 35.5-36.3s]

HER CLOSE: 'yalla, I'm Iraqi' (she is from Morocco - the two of them bond on it), 'nice to meet you', 'be healthy', 'bye, my love' [framing: manual full-height centre crop - the auto face-aim put the crop top-left on passers-by in V1 r1] [in 43.2->42.95, same reason]
ENDING a: observer iPhone, later on the lit street - he stops the cart, turns to camera and smiles holding the red roses. Wordless hold. Proxy only (360p)
ENDING b: after a jump in the source clip itself (7.5s), he steps forward grinning with the roses - 'thank you'. The face with the flowers is the last image
